products.name: Recorlev
products.description: Recorlev is a cortisol synthesis inhibitor in a solid oral dosage form, manufactured using conventional pharmaceutical processes, and distributed via specialty pharmacy for the treatment of endogenous Cushing’s syndrome in adults for whom surgery is not an option or has not been curative.

products.name: Gvoke
products.description: Gvoke is a ready-to-use, room-temperature stable, liquid glucagon product for the treatment of severe hypoglycemia, available in multiple subcutaneous injectable presentations (auto-injector, pre-filled syringe, kit), manufactured using proprietary non-aqueous formulation technology and distributed through specialty pharmacy channels.

products.name: Keveyis
products.description: Keveyis is an oral therapy (dichlorphenamide) for the treatment of Primary Periodic Paralysis (PPP), a rare neuromuscular disorder, manufactured and packaged by third-party pharmaceutical partners and distributed via specialty pharmacy.

products.name: XP-8121 (Once-Weekly Subcutaneous Levothyroxine)
products.description: XP-8121 is a pipeline product in development, designed as a once-weekly, small-volume, subcutaneous injectable formulation of levothyroxine for hypothyroidism, leveraging proprietary XeriSol non-aqueous technology to bypass gastrointestinal absorption issues associated with daily oral therapy.

products.name: Formulation and Development Partnerships (XeriSol and XeriJect Technologies)
products.description: Xeris offers formulation and development partnerships to pharmaceutical companies, applying its proprietary XeriSol and XeriJect non-aqueous formulation technologies to enhance the drug delivery and clinical profile of other companies’ proprietary drugs and biologics, including small molecules, peptides, biologics, and monoclonal antibodies.

products.name: Premium Subscription Video Services
products.description: Starz provides premium subscription video programming, including original series and movies, delivered via over-the-top streaming platforms, direct-to-consumer apps, and through multichannel video programming distributors. The service is digital-only and accessible on various devices and platforms.

products.name: Linear Premium Television Networks
products.description: Starz operates 17 linear premium television networks, offering scheduled, advertisement-free exhibition of original series and movies to subscribers via cable, satellite, and telecommunications distributors. Delivery requires regulated infrastructure and agreements with distributors.

products.name: Content Licensing (Original and Acquired Programming)
products.description: Starz licenses original and acquired content, including first-run movies and television series, to its own platforms and networks, securing exclusive rights through multiyear output and library agreements with major studios and content owners. This involves financial capital and legal agreements.

products.name: Digital Advertising Services
products.description: Travelzoo provides digital advertising and marketing services to travel, entertainment, and local businesses, enabling them to promote offers via email, websites, social media, mobile apps, and a network of third-party sites. This is delivered through proprietary digital platforms and includes real-time offer listings, audience targeting, and performance tracking.

products.name: Travel and Local Offer Vouchers
products.description: Travelzoo sells vouchers for curated travel, entertainment, and local experiences (such as hotels, spas, restaurants, and activities) negotiated with providers. These vouchers are purchased by members via the website, newsletters, and mobile apps, and redeemed with the provider.

products.name: Paid Membership Subscriptions (Travelzoo Club)
products.description: Travelzoo offers a paid membership club for travel enthusiasts, providing access to exclusive, rigorously vetted travel and local offers, special member events, and additional benefits such as lounge access and travel assistance. Membership is delivered digitally and requires an annual fee.

products.name: Jack’s Flight Club Subscription Service
products.description: Jack’s Flight Club is a subscription-based service providing members with curated alerts about exceptional airfares, delivered via email newsletters, website, and mobile app. The service uses technology and expert curation to identify and notify members of flight deals.

products.name: Metaverse Travel and Entertainment Experiences
products.description: Through Travelzoo META, the company offers immersive, virtual travel and entertainment experiences in the Metaverse, leveraging digital platforms and acquired technology to provide new forms of engagement for travel enthusiasts.

products.name: Licensing of Travelzoo Products and Intellectual Property
products.description: Travelzoo licenses its products, services, and intellectual property to third-party licensees in select international markets, generating royalty revenue based on a percentage of net revenue from these territories.

products.name: Toys and Action Figures
products.description: Manufactured and sold globally, these include action figures, dolls, play sets, preschool toys, plush products, vehicles, arts and crafts, and other toy-related specialty products based on Hasbro's owned and licensed brands. Distributed through retail, ecommerce, and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Board Games and Tabletop Games
products.description: Physical board and tabletop games, including classic and new titles, manufactured and distributed globally. Delivered through retail, ecommerce, and direct-to-consumer channels, these games target a wide demographic from children to adults.

products.name: Trading Card Games and Collectibles
products.description: Physical and digital trading card games and collectibles, primarily MAGIC: THE GATHERING, produced and distributed globally. Includes exclusive and limited editions sold via direct-to-consumer platforms and retail.

products.name: Role-Playing Games
products.description: Tabletop role-playing games, primarily DUNGEONS & DRAGONS, including physical books, accessories, and digital content. Delivered through retail, ecommerce, and digital platforms.

products.name: Digital Games and Video Games
products.description: Development, publishing, and licensing of digital games for PC, console, and mobile platforms, including adaptations of Hasbro brands and original titles. Delivered via digital storefronts and partnerships with external studios.

products.name: Consumer Products Licensing
products.description: Out-licensing of Hasbro's intellectual property for use in a variety of consumer products, including apparel, publishing, home goods, electronics, and certain toy categories. Partners manufacture and distribute these products under license.

products.name: Digital Games Licensing
products.description: Licensing Hasbro brands to third-party developers for the creation and distribution of digital games, including mobile, PC, and console titles. Revenue is generated through royalties and licensing fees.

products.name: Location-Based Entertainment Licensing
products.description: Licensing Hasbro brands for use in theme parks, family entertainment centers, live shows, exhibits, and other location-based experiences operated by third parties. Hasbro receives royalties and brand exposure.

products.name: Entertainment Content Production and Licensing
products.description: Production and licensing of entertainment content, including television, film, and digital programming, primarily to reinforce brand storylines and generate licensing and merchandising revenues. Content is distributed through various media channels and partners.

products.name: Direct-to-Consumer Platforms
products.description: Operation of proprietary ecommerce and digital platforms (e.g., Hasbro Pulse, Secret Lair, Magic: The Gathering Arena, D&D Beyond) to sell exclusive products, digital content, and collectibles directly to fans and consumers.

products.name: Commercial Landscape Maintenance Services
products.description: Recurring, route-based landscape maintenance services for commercial clients, including mowing, gardening, mulching, irrigation maintenance, water management, tree care, and golf course maintenance. Services are primarily self-performed through a national branch network and require in-person labor and specialized equipment.

products.name: Landscape Enhancement Services
products.description: Supplemental, non-contract specified maintenance or improvement services sold to maintenance customers, such as upgrades, improvements, and cleanup, typically delivered by in-person crews using specialized equipment.

products.name: Snow Removal Services
products.description: Seasonal snow and ice removal services for commercial properties, including plowing, de-icing, and related winter maintenance, delivered by in-person crews using specialized vehicles and equipment. Some services are provided under fixed-fee contracts with guaranteed minimum payments.

products.name: Commercial Landscape Development Services
products.description: Design, project management, and installation of new landscapes and major redesigns for commercial clients, including landscape architecture, irrigation installation, tree moving, pool and water features, sports field and specialty turf services. Projects are typically large-scale, complex, and require both in-house and subcontracted labor.

products.name: Investment Servicing
products.description: Comprehensive asset servicing solutions for institutional investors, including custody, fund administration, accounting, recordkeeping, transaction management, collateral services, performance analytics, and outsourcing. Delivered through a combination of specialized banking operations, technology platforms, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Trading and Markets Services
products.description: Foreign exchange, brokerage, and other trading services, as well as securities finance and prime services, provided to institutional clients through regulated market operations and technology platforms.

products.name: Front- and Middle-Office Investment Technology Platforms
products.description: Integrated technology platforms for portfolio management, trading, execution, analytics, compliance, and data aggregation, including the State Street Alpha platform and Charles River suite, delivered as digital solutions to institutional investors and wealth managers.

products.name: Digital Asset Solutions
products.description: End-to-end digital asset servicing and tokenization solutions for institutional clients, leveraging secure, interoperable platforms with blockchain connectivity. Delivered through digital infrastructure and regulated processes.

products.name: Investment Management
products.description: Comprehensive investment management solutions across equity, fixed income, liquidity, cash, multi-asset, and alternative strategies, delivered through ETFs, custom indexed, and actively managed funds and mandates. Requires financial capital, portfolio management expertise, and regulated fund structures.

products.name: Engines
products.description: Manufactures and markets a broad range of diesel, natural gas, and gasoline-powered engines for heavy-duty, medium-duty, light-duty automotive, and off-highway markets. Products include new and remanufactured engines and parts, produced in Cummins facilities and sold globally through OEMs and distributors.

products.name: Power Generation Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells standby and prime power generators (2 kW to 3.5 MW), controls, paralleling systems, and transfer switches for data centers, commercial, industrial, healthcare, rental, and defense applications. Delivered as turnkey solutions using diesel, natural gas, battery energy storage, and alternative fuels.

products.name: Drivetrain and Braking Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and supplies drivetrain systems including axles, drivelines, brakes, and suspension systems for commercial vehicle and industrial applications. Products are manufactured in Cummins and joint venture facilities and sold to OEMs and aftermarket channels globally.

products.name: Emission Solutions (Aftertreatment Systems)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and integrates aftertreatment technology and solutions (oxidation catalysts, particulate filters, SCR systems, dosers) for on- and off-highway engine markets to meet emissions standards. Products are sold to OEMs for first fit and retrofit applications worldwide.

products.name: Turbochargers, Fuel Systems, and Valvetrain Technologies
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets turbochargers, fuel systems, and valvetrain technologies for light-, medium-, heavy-duty, and high-horsepower engines. Products are produced in Cummins and joint venture facilities and sold to OEMs and engine manufacturers globally.

products.name: Automated Transmissions
products.description: Develops and supplies automated manual and automatic transmissions for heavy-duty commercial vehicles, primarily through the Eaton Cummins Automated Transmission Technologies joint venture. Products are manufactured and sold in North America and China.

products.name: A/C Generators and Alternators
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells A/C generator/alternator products and components (7.5 kVA to 11,200 kVA) under the Stamford and AVK brands for use in generator sets and by external generator set assemblers worldwide.

products.name: Electrified Power Systems and Components (Accelera)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, sells, and supports electrified power systems and components, including battery and electric powertrain technologies, for commercial and industrial applications. Products are produced in Cummins facilities and sold to OEMs and end-users globally.

products.name: Distribution, Sales, and Aftermarket Services
products.description: Provides sales, service, and support for Cummins products through a global network of wholly-owned, joint venture, and independent distribution locations. Services include application engineering, custom assemblies, retail and wholesale parts, and in-shop and field-based repair.

products.name: Oil and Gas Exploration and Production
products.description: Exploration, development, and production of crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGLs) from offshore fields, primarily in the U.S. Gulf of America Deepwater, Shelf, Gulf Coast, and shallow waters offshore Mexico. This involves physical drilling, seismic imaging, and operation of offshore platforms and wells, requiring significant technical, engineering, and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Autonomous Sidewalk Delivery Services
products.description: Serve provides last-mile delivery services using a fleet of proprietary, AI-enabled sidewalk robots that autonomously transport goods such as food and small packages from merchants to customers in public and commercial spaces. The service is enabled by physical manufacturing of robots, integration with delivery platforms, and remote fleet management.

products.name: Autonomous Indoor Logistics Solutions for Healthcare
products.description: Following the acquisition of Diligent Robotics, Serve offers autonomous robot assistants (e.g., Moxi robots) that perform routine logistical tasks within hospital environments, such as delivering medications, lab samples, and supplies. These solutions are delivered via physical robots equipped with AI and sensors, operating autonomously in indoor healthcare settings.

products.name: Out-of-Home (OOH) Robotic Advertising Services
products.description: Serve offers advertising services by placing brand advertisements on the exteriors of its delivery robots and through experiential marketing initiatives, leveraging the visibility of its robotic fleet in public spaces. This service is delivered via physical branding and event-based activations using the robot fleet.

products.name: Robotic Platform Software Licensing and Data Services
products.description: Serve licenses its proprietary robotic platform software and offers data monetization services to partners, providing recurring software-based solutions that complement its core robotic operations. These are digital-only offerings leveraging Serve’s AI and fleet management infrastructure.

products.name: Eyeglasses
products.description: Prescription eyeglasses, including frames and lenses, are manufactured in centralized laboratories and on-site labs, and sold through retail stores and omni-channel platforms. Products include a wide range of brand-name, private label, and premium/luxury frames, as well as lenses with various treatments and advanced materials.

products.name: Contact Lenses
products.description: Contact lenses from major manufacturers and private label brands are sold through retail stores and a dedicated e-commerce website. The company manages fulfillment and distribution via third-party vendors and offers frequent repurchase options due to the disposable nature of the product.

products.name: Eye Exams and Vision Care Services
products.description: Comprehensive eye exams and vision care services are provided by optometrists in-store or via remote telehealth technology, using both in-person and telemedicine platforms. Services are delivered through company-employed, contracted, or independent optometrists, and include routine exams and prescription renewals.

products.name: Eyewear Accessories
products.description: A variety of eyewear accessories, such as cases, cleaning supplies, and related products, are sold alongside eyeglasses and contact lenses in retail stores and online. These are sourced from various vendors and offered as add-on purchases.

products.name: Eyecare Club Memberships
products.description: Multi-year membership programs, primarily for contact lens customers, provide bundled benefits such as multiple eye exams per year and discounts on eyeglasses and contact lenses for a fixed upfront payment. These programs are designed to drive repeat visits and customer loyalty.

products.name: Product Protection Plans (Eyeglass Warranties)
products.description: Extended warranty and product protection plans for eyeglasses are offered, providing repair or replacement services for a fee. These plans are regulated as service contracts in certain states and are sold as add-ons to eyewear purchases.

products.name: Smart Eyewear
products.description: Smart eyewear products, such as AI-enabled or connected glasses (e.g., Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses), are offered as part of the premium eyewear assortment. These products integrate vision correction with digital features and are sourced from leading manufacturers.

products.name: Recombinant Cell Culture Media Proteins
products.description: Animal-free recombinant proteins such as albumin, transferrin, and fibroblast growth factor produced via microbial fermentation for use as growth media components in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, diagnostics, and research. Delivered as purified proteins through direct sales, OEM supply, and licensing agreements.

products.name: Molecular Biology and Diagnostic Enzymes
products.description: Recombinant enzymes and proteins (e.g., DNase I, RNase inhibitors, T7 RNA polymerase, DNA ligase, polymerases) produced using proprietary microbial platforms for use in molecular biology, diagnostics, and nucleic acid processing. Delivered as purified reagents for research and diagnostic applications.

products.name: Animal-Free Dairy and Nutritional Proteins
products.description: Recombinant dairy proteins (e.g., bovine and human alpha-lactalbumin, human lactoferrin, caseins) and enzymes (e.g., chymosin) produced via precision fermentation for use in dairy alternatives, infant formula, medical nutrition, and food processing. Delivered as ingredients to food and nutrition manufacturers through direct sales and licensing.

products.name: Industrial Enzymes for Bio-Industrial Applications
products.description: Recombinant enzymes (e.g., EN3ZYME™ cocktail) produced using microbial expression platforms for applications in biomass processing, biofuels, pulp and paper, and other industrial biotechnology markets. Delivered as enzyme preparations to industrial customers via direct sales, OEM supply, and revenue-sharing collaborations.

products.name: Biopharmaceutical Protein Production and Licensing
products.description: Licensing of the C1 microbial expression platform and related technology for the production of recombinant therapeutic proteins, including vaccines, monoclonal antibodies, and other biologics for human and animal health. Revenue generated through licensing fees, milestones, royalties, and funded collaborations with pharmaceutical and biotech partners.

products.name: Unified Commerce SaaS Solutions
products.description: A suite of microservices-based, cloud-native SaaS applications for retail and restaurant customers, covering ordering, checkout, fulfillment, loyalty, marketing, site operations, and corporate planning. Delivered digitally via the Voyix Commerce Platform, these solutions are modular, scalable, and integrate with both digital and physical channels.

products.name: Point-of-Sale (POS) Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based and hybrid-cloud POS software and hardware solutions for retailers and restaurants, enabling front- and back-of-house operations, integrated with the Voyix Commerce Platform. Delivered as software and paired with hardware options, including terminals and peripherals.

products.name: Self-Checkout (SCO) Solutions
products.description: Self-checkout technology for retail environments, allowing consumers to transact independently using hardware and software that integrates bar code scanning, computer vision, and RFID. Delivered as standalone or hybrid units, with embedded AI and machine learning features.

products.name: Omnichannel Payment Solutions
products.description: End-to-end payment processing and gateway services integrated with POS and SCO offerings, supporting in-store and online transactions (credit, debit, gift, loyalty, fleet, fuel cards). Delivered via cloud-native platforms with secure payment terminals, hosted pay pages, and APIs.

products.name: Professional and Managed Services
products.description: A comprehensive suite of services including software implementation, integration, localization, optimization, managed platform operations, and 24/7 support. Delivered through remote and on-site human labor, supporting both proprietary and third-party technology.

products.name: Field Support and Deployment Services
products.description: On-site and remote hardware maintenance, break-fix, installation, and repair services for both NCR Voyix and third-party hardware, delivered by a global field services team and logistics network.

products.name: Retail and Restaurant Hardware Solutions
products.description: Sales of POS, self-checkout, and related hardware (including peripherals like kitchen display systems, printers, kiosks, cash drawers, keyboards, scanners, and payment terminals), now primarily as a sales agent for Ennoconn. Hardware is manufactured by third parties and integrated with Voyix software.

products.name: Consumer Experience, Loyalty & Marketing Solutions
products.description: SaaS applications for managing promotions, rewards programs, and marketing campaigns, providing actionable insights and supporting multiple languages and currencies. Delivered digitally as part of the Voyix Commerce Platform.

products.name: Site Operations & Corporate Planning Solutions
products.description: Advanced SaaS tools for managing labor, inventory, supply chain, communication, and automation in retail and restaurant operations. Delivered digitally, leveraging AI and analytics to optimize and scale operations.

products.name: Placental Allograft Products
products.description: Human tissue allografts derived from donated placental membrane, umbilical cord, and placental disc, processed using proprietary methods (e.g., PURION process) for use in advanced wound care and surgical applications. Manufactured in-house and available in various configurations and sizes.

products.name: Xenograft Collagen Matrix Products
products.description: Animal-derived (primarily bovine) collagen matrix products, including particulate and powder forms, used for wound management and surgical applications. Manufactured by third parties and distributed exclusively by MIMEDX.

products.name: Advanced Wound Care Dressings and Skin Substitutes
products.description: A portfolio of advanced wound care products, including autologous PRP/ATS wound gels, bioglass/collagen wound matrices, and flowable peptide matrices, used for the treatment of chronic and acute wounds. These products are sourced via exclusive distribution agreements and target complex wound healing needs.

products.name: Surgical Tissue Repair and Reinforcement Products
products.description: Tissue-based and synthetic products, including placental allografts and xenografts, used in a variety of surgical specialties for acute wound closure, tissue reinforcement, and protection of sensitive tissues during procedures. Delivered through direct sales and distribution agreements.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: Ownership and participation in the development and production of oil and natural gas wells, primarily as a non-operator, by acquiring working and mineral interests in producing wells, near-term development opportunities, and undeveloped acreage. Production is physically extracted by third-party operators and sold into commodity markets.

products.name: Quick Service Restaurant Food and Beverage Sales
products.description: Operation and franchising of quick service restaurants under the Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes, and Firehouse Subs brands, offering a range of food and beverage products including coffee, baked goods, hamburgers, chicken, sandwiches, and subs. Products are prepared in physical restaurant locations and delivered to customers via dine-in, takeout, drive-thru, and delivery channels.

products.name: Franchise Restaurant Operations and Support
products.description: Provision of franchise rights, operational support, training, and brand systems to independent franchisees who operate restaurants under the company's brands. Includes franchise agreements, royalty income, and ongoing operational and marketing support. Delivered through legal agreements, training programs, and brand management infrastructure.

products.name: Restaurant Supply Chain and Distribution Services
products.description: Manufacturing, procurement, warehousing, and distribution of food, packaging, and equipment products to company-owned and franchised restaurants, primarily for Tim Hortons in Canada and the U.S. Includes proprietary coffee roasting, fondant and syrup manufacturing, and logistics operations using company-owned distribution centers and delivery vehicles.

products.name: Packaged Coffee and Related Retail Products
products.description: Production and sale of take-home, packaged coffee and related products under the Tim Hortons brand, distributed through restaurants and third-party retail channels. Products are manufactured in company-owned or third-party facilities and sold for off-premise consumption.

products.name: Broadcast Radio Advertising
products.description: Selling advertising time on a network of over 860 AM/FM radio stations across approximately 160 U.S. markets. This is delivered via physical radio infrastructure and regulated by the FCC.

products.name: Digital Audio Advertising and Streaming Services
products.description: Providing free, ad-supported and subscription-based digital audio streaming through the iHeartRadio platform, available on 500+ platforms and thousands of devices. Monetization occurs via digital advertising and subscriptions.

products.name: Podcast Production and Advertising
products.description: Producing, distributing, and monetizing podcasts across all major content categories, including ad sales and sponsorships. Delivered digitally via proprietary and third-party platforms.

products.name: Network Syndication and Content Distribution
products.description: Syndicating radio programs and services, including top talent shows, to over 6,700 radio station affiliates and providing national advertising opportunities. Delivered via broadcast and digital channels.

products.name: Traffic, Weather, and Information Services
products.description: Providing real-time local traffic, weather, sports, and news updates to radio and television affiliates, as well as through digital partnerships. Delivered via broadcast, internet, and mobile platforms.

products.name: Live and Virtual Events
products.description: Producing and monetizing live and virtual events, including major music festivals, award shows, and branded experiences. Revenue streams include sponsorships, advertising, ticket sales, and licensing.

products.name: Advertising Technology Solutions
products.description: Offering cross-platform ad tech solutions for audio, including programmatic ad buying, data targeting, attribution, and analytics for advertisers. Delivered via proprietary technology platforms and software.

products.name: Media Representation Services
products.description: Representing non-iHeartMedia radio and television stations for advertising sales, earning commissions on media sold. Delivered through Katz Media Group to over 3,400 radio and 400 television stations.

products.name: Broadcast and Media Software Solutions
products.description: Providing cloud and on-premises software for radio and television automation, music scheduling, newsroom automation, and advertising sales management to broadcasters and media companies worldwide.

products.name: Lease-to-Own (LTO) Platform for Durable Goods
products.description: A technology-driven, fully digital platform that enables nonprime U.S. consumers to lease and potentially purchase everyday durable goods (such as home furnishings, automotive goods, computers, electronics, and appliances) from integrated omnichannel and e-commerce retailers. The platform uses proprietary underwriting and integrates with merchant POS systems, waterfall financing platforms, and a mobile app marketplace, delivering a seamless, automated approval and payment process.

products.name: Katapult App Marketplace and KPay Virtual Card
products.description: A mobile app-based marketplace allowing consumers to shop with a variety of durable goods merchants using a proprietary virtual credit card (KPay) to complete lease-to-own transactions. The app leverages real-time eligibility determination and enables shopping with over 250 merchants, providing a digital-only, integrated shopping and leasing experience.

products.name: Value-Added Frozen Potato Products
products.description: Manufactured and distributed frozen potato products, primarily French fries, produced in company-owned and co-packed facilities and delivered through a global distribution network to foodservice, retail, and institutional customers.

products.name: Frozen Appetizers
products.description: Manufactured and distributed frozen appetizer products, such as potato-based snacks, produced in company-owned and co-packed facilities and sold to foodservice and retail customers.

products.name: Commercial Potato Ingredients
products.description: Processed potato ingredients (such as potato flakes and granules) manufactured for use by other food producers and commercial customers, delivered in bulk or packaged formats.

products.name: Sportsbook (Sports Betting)
products.description: Online and retail sports betting services where customers place wagers on sporting events at fixed odds, delivered via proprietary digital platforms and physical betting shops, requiring regulated infrastructure and risk management.

products.name: iGaming (Casino, Poker, Bingo, Machine Gaming)
products.description: Online and retail gaming products including casino games (slots, blackjack, roulette), poker, bingo, and machine gaming terminals, delivered through digital platforms and physical locations, combining third-party and proprietary content under strict regulatory oversight.

products.name: Lottery Products
products.description: Retail and online lottery products where customers purchase tickets for a chance to win prizes, operated under fixed-term government concessions in various jurisdictions and requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Exchange Betting
products.description: Peer-to-peer sports betting platform where customers bet against each other rather than the house, with the company earning commissions on matched bets, delivered digitally and requiring liquidity management and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Pari-Mutuel Horse Racing Wagering
products.description: Online and retail pari-mutuel wagering services for horse racing, where bets are pooled and payouts are determined by the pool size, delivered via digital platforms and television networks under state and federal regulation.

products.name: Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS)
products.description: Paid-entry and free-to-play daily fantasy sports contests where customers assemble virtual teams and compete for prizes, delivered through digital platforms and requiring compliance with varying state regulations.

products.name: Prediction Markets
products.description: Digital platforms allowing customers to trade contracts on the outcome of specified events, regulated as futures markets and delivered via web and mobile applications in partnership with financial exchanges.

products.name: Business-to-Business Pricing and Risk Management Services
products.description: Provision of pricing and risk management services to other businesses in the betting and gaming sector, leveraging proprietary technology and expertise, delivered under service agreements.

products.name: Digital Wholesale Vehicle Marketplace
products.description: A technology-driven online platform facilitating real-time auctions and transactions of wholesale used vehicles between dealers and commercial partners, accessible via web, mobile apps, and API integration. The platform is supported by remarketing centers and offers various auction formats.

products.name: Vehicle Transportation Services
products.description: A nationwide service enabling the movement of vehicles purchased through the marketplace, utilizing a network of third-party carrier partners, technology platform, and dedicated service teams to provide real-time quotes and status tracking.

products.name: Inventory Financing (Floorplan Loans)
products.description: Short-term inventory financing solutions (floorplan loans) for dealers to purchase vehicles, with transparent pricing and integrated into the marketplace transaction process.

products.name: Seller and Buyer Assurance Services
products.description: Assurance products for sellers and buyers, including defect protection (Go Green), price guarantees, and arbitration support, designed to instill confidence and reduce transaction risk in digital vehicle sales.

products.name: Vehicle Inspection and Condition Reporting
products.description: Comprehensive vehicle inspection services and detailed condition reports, including proprietary technologies like Virtual Lift and Apex sensors, providing cosmetic, structural, and mechanical assessments for transparency in transactions.

products.name: Vehicle Reconditioning and Storage Services
products.description: Physical services at remarketing centers, including vehicle reconditioning and storage, to prepare vehicles for auction and facilitate transactions for commercial partners such as fleet and rental companies.

products.name: Automotive Data and Analytics Services
products.description: Provision of data-driven insights, analytics, and reports (such as True360 and ACV Market Report) on vehicle condition, value, and market trends, supporting inventory management, pricing, and decision-making for dealers and commercial partners both on and off the marketplace.

products.name: Inventory Management Software
products.description: Software tools (such as ACV MAX) leveraging predictive analytics and artificial intelligence to help dealers manage inventory, set pricing, and optimize vehicle turnover and profitability.

products.name: Private Marketplace Solutions
products.description: Customizable private digital marketplaces for dealer groups and commercial partners, allowing tailored auctions with specific participants, schedules, and rules, delivered via a co-branded interface.

products.name: Programmatic Buying Tools
products.description: APIs and user interfaces enabling automated, rules-based vehicle sourcing and bidding for dealers, integrating with customer technology platforms for efficient inventory acquisition.

products.name: Environmental Maintenance Vehicles and Equipment
products.description: Manufactured vehicles and equipment for municipal and industrial maintenance, including street sweepers, sewer cleaners, industrial vacuum loaders, vacuum- and hydro-excavation trucks, waterblasting equipment, refuse collection vehicles, road-marking and line-removal equipment, dump truck bodies, trailers, metal extraction support equipment, and multi-purpose maintenance vehicles. These are produced in physical manufacturing facilities and delivered via dealer networks or direct sales.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts, Service, Rentals, and Training
products.description: Comprehensive aftermarket offering including the sale of parts, service and repair, equipment rentals, and training for maintenance vehicles and equipment. Delivered through service centers across North America, requiring in-person human labor and logistics.

products.name: Safety and Security Systems
products.description: Manufactured and supplied systems and products for public safety and industrial signaling, including vehicle lightbars and sirens, industrial signaling equipment, public warning systems, and general alarm/public address systems. These are produced in manufacturing facilities and delivered to law enforcement, emergency services, industrial, and governmental customers.

products.name: Leaf Tobacco Products and Services
products.description: Procurement, processing, packing, storage, and shipment of flue-cured, burley, dark air-cured, and oriental leaf tobacco for manufacturers of consumer tobacco products, including custom blending, testing, service cutting, reconstituted leaf manufacturing, and just-in-time delivery. Requires global agricultural sourcing, physical processing in factories, and regulated supply chain infrastructure.

products.name: Liquid Nicotine and Tobacco By-Products
products.description: Production and supply of liquid nicotine for manufacturers of next generation tobacco products and sale of recycled waste materials from tobacco production. Involves extraction and processing of tobacco derivatives for industrial customers.

products.name: Plant-Based Ingredients
products.description: Procurement and processing of fruits, vegetables, and botanicals into value-added ingredients such as juices, concentrates, dehydrated products, extracts, and flavorings for food, beverage, and pet food manufacturers. Delivered through specialized manufacturing facilities and global sourcing networks.

products.name: Botanical Extracts, Natural Flavors, and Colors
products.description: Manufacture and supply of botanical extracts, distillates, natural flavors, and colors, including vanilla products, for industrial and private label customers. Includes custom bottling and packaging services. Production is based in specialized extraction and blending facilities.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full range of commercial banking services including commercial loans (for corporate purposes, real estate, construction, land development), deposit accounts, and treasury management, delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Banking services for individual consumers, including checking, savings, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, individual retirement accounts, installment and real estate loans, and lines of credit, delivered via branches and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Origination, construction financing, production, secondary marketing, and servicing of conventional and government-insured residential mortgages, involving both in-person and digital processes, and requiring regulatory compliance and financial capital.

products.name: Wealth Management and Fiduciary Services
